description: This Java class, RequireNameValidator, is a validator used in the OpenMRS project to ensure that objects have a non-empty 'name' property. It implements the Spring Validator interface and provides support check and validation logic.

classes.name: RequireNameValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks whether an object has a non-empty 'name' property.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the class of the given object, by verifying if a 'name' property with getter and setter exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the object, requiring that the 'name' property is not null, empty, or whitespace.
